quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: Acuity acquired QSC, LLC on January 1, 2025; the acquired developed technology was substantially all Q-SYS, an audio, video and control platform. QSC contributed net sales of $428.6 million in fiscal 2025 since the acquisition date.
quarterly_data.figure: QSC net sales $428.6 million in fiscal 2025 since acquisition

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K manufacturing and supply: Acuity operates eighteen manufacturing facilities - seven in Mexico, six in the United States, three in Canada and two in Europe - and uses contract manufacturing from U.S., Asian and European sources for certain products. Raw materials and components include steel, aluminum, certain rare earth materials, microchips, LEDs, LED drivers, electronic components, power supplies and copper; supply chain disruptions for certain components including microchips and electronics have raised prices, and a limited number of suppliers for certain components and purchased finished goods results, on a limited basis, in sole-source supplier situations.
quarterly_data.figure: eighteen manufacturing facilities (seven in Mexico, six in the United States, three in Canada, two in Europe)
